claim: OUT-002 plans a deterministic source-bound compiler followed by source-bound admission and revision with disjoint lock roots, checkpoint-first and receipt-last publication, fail-closed abort recovery, explicit quiescence input, and closed-projection carry-forward.
evidence: Task 1 covers canonical schema-v2 derivation, deterministic outcome scopes, whole-document source hashes, and ordered typed diagnostics without reshaping bootstrap authority.
Task 2 uses an isolated delivery persistence root and disjoint orchestration, package, and target locks, preserving the live bootstrap reader until adapter cutover.
A rejected package publication unwinds commit locks before caller-side abort restores prior bytes and removes the staged manifest, preventing later recovery from publishing rejected authority.
The consolidated admission proof verifies callback mismatch remains rejected even after a later recovery-triggering package operation.

Revision accepts explicit active claim identities, rejects non-empty before mutation, preserves identity bindings only for byte-identical closed outcome projections, and invalidates changed dependent closure.
Two tasks cover all OUT-002 acceptance and linked commitments without adapter, migration, compatibility, public-lock, or duplicate-test scope.
